entities.summary: Amarjit Singh Rana is a former field hockey player from India. He was part of the Indian hockey team which won the gold medal in hockey in the 1980 Summer Olympics at Moscow. Amarjit Singh Rana was a athletes & competitors from Khusropur (b. 1960-02-03, Khusropur). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
